description: A channel an event's #[BroadcastsOn] declares but no feature test broadcasts it on, a stale declaration whose listeners would never hear it, is a Contract Coverage gap.

expect.errorContains: ✗ ProjectUpdated on App.Models.User.{id}: no feature test broadcasts this event on this channel: add a feature test that broadcasts App\Events\ProjectUpdated on it, or remove #[BroadcastsOn('App.Models.User.{id}')] if it is never sent there.
